title: Hitler regime support for Zionist revolutionary groups

tellings.quote: the the Hitler regime did lend support to the uh at that time the sort of Zionist movement to

plain: On the podcast of a host named Jesse Michels, a researcher named Matthew Brown says that Hitler's government in Germany gave some support, in the 1930s and 1940s, to the Zionist movement, the movement working toward a Jewish homeland in what was then British-ruled Palestine. He gives it as a summary and names no source. He raises it as part of a wider argument that hidden powers back unlikely allies to steer history.
